conditions: opt_out_flag is true
cohort_or_field_set: suppression_reason set to opted_out and lead_state set to opted_out
cta: none
notes: No outbound of any category including transactional confirmations except a legally required receipt

conditions: invalid_number_flag is true OR last_message_status is failed on three consecutive sends
cta: none
notes: Route to data quality queue and attempt one email if consent exists

conditions: consent_marketing is false AND whatsapp_optin_status is not opted_in
cta: Reply YES to receive it here
notes: Only a single opt in request may be sent. Utility template category only. Requires platform compliance review

conditions: dnd_flag is yes
cta: none
notes: WhatsApp with opt in remains permitted. Requires legal verification

conditions: payment_completed_at is set AND days since payment below 30
cohort_or_field_set: lead_state set to converted and retargeting_eligible set to false
cta: Access your course
notes: Prevents the common failure of marketing to a paying student

conditions: duplicate_status is duplicate_merged
cta: none
notes: Never send a second first message to the same person

conditions: current local time outside 08:00 to 21:00 IST
cta: none
notes: Queue and release at the next permitted window

conditions: messages sent today at or above the cohort daily cap
cta: none
notes: Cap is 1 per day for nurture and 3 per day for transactional threads

conditions: payment_failure_count at 1 or above AND payment_completed_at is null
cohort_or_field_set: lead_state set to payment_failed and intent_temperature set to transactional
cta: Try again on this link or tell me what went wrong
notes: Counsellor task at priority P0 within 30 minutes inside calling hours

conditions: checkout_started_at is set AND payment_completed_at is null AND 2 hours elapsed
cta: Pick up where you left off
notes: Three attempts at 2 hours 24 hours and 72 hours then counsellor call

conditions: payment_completed_at is set
cta: Your access details
notes: Fires onboarding and cross sell eligibility timer at 60 percent completion

conditions: Lead asked for a payment link
cohort_or_field_set: payment_link_requested set to true and intent_temperature set to transactional
cta: Confirming the variant then sending the link
notes: Never send the link before variant and price are confirmed

conditions: Lead asked for fees or price
cohort_or_field_set: blocking_objection may be price and intent_score plus 16
cta: Which variant are we deciding between
notes: Answer with a number and the variant it belongs to. Never deflect to a call first

conditions: Lead asked for the next batch date
cta: Which start date works
notes: Only quote batches with a future start date

conditions: Lead asked for a demo or sample class
cta: Sending the class link
notes: Counsellor task after watch percentage is known

conditions: Lead asked for a callback
cta: Confirming a window that works for you
notes: Ask for the window. Never promise a counsellor will call soon with no time

conditions: Lead asked for EMI or instalments
cta: How the instalments work
notes: Counsellor handoff at P1

conditions: Lead asked for counselling or career guidance
cta: Pick a slot
notes: Booking link plus one reminder

conditions: Lead asked for the syllabus or coverage
cta: Full coverage and hours
notes: Send the coverage not the brochure

conditions: Lead asked to stop or wrote stop or unsubscribe or remove
cta: none
notes: Confirm once then suppress permanently

conditions: Lead asked a question the automation cannot classify with confidence above 0.7
cta: none
notes: Never guess an answer to a question you did not understand

conditions: promised_resource_id is set AND promised_resource_delivered is false
cta: Sending what you signed up for
notes: The most common trust failure in EdTech is asking a question before honouring the promise

conditions: source_detail is resource_download AND the resource was delivered
cta: One question so I send the right next thing
notes: Diagnostic must reference the resource the lead actually opened

conditions: source_detail is webinar_registration AND event has not yet occurred
cta: Joining link and time
overrides: Blocks sales content until the event
notes: Do not sell before delivering the event

conditions: source_detail is webinar_attendee
cta: Continue from what was covered
notes: First message must reference event_topic. Never ask whether they are interested in finance

conditions: source_detail is webinar_noshow
cta: Recording plus the one thing most people ask after
overrides: Blocks sales content for one message
notes: Send the recording before anything else

conditions: eligibility_status is ineligible for course_interest_primary
cta: Here is the route that is open to you now
notes: Never issue a payment link. State the reason plainly and name the nearest eligible product

conditions: eligibility_status is not_yet_eligible AND a date can be calculated
cohort_or_field_set: next_action_at set to the eligibility date minus 60 days
cta: I will come back to you when the window opens
notes: Dated re entry rather than repeated follow up

conditions: stage_suitability is premature
cohort_or_field_set: course_interest_secondary set to the recommended entry product
cta: The step before this one is what actually fits now
notes: Explain the sequence rather than refusing

conditions: eligibility_status is unknown AND intent_temperature is high or transactional
cta: One quick check before we go further
notes: Verification task for the counsellor

conditions: intent_score at 81 or above AND fit_score at 35 or above
cohort_or_field_set: lead_state set to sales_qualified and priority_band P0
cta: Confirming your batch and variant
notes: Counsellor call within 30 minutes inside calling hours

conditions: purchase_timeline is immediate or within_7_days AND course_specificity is specific or transactional
cta: Class link plus the next start date
notes: Two assets maximum. Sample class and schedule

conditions: life_stage is working professional AND course_specificity is specific AND purchase_timeline within 30 days
cta: Which of these two variants fits your week
notes: This is the exact case the brief calls out. No beginner sequence

conditions: competitor_named is not none
cta: Fifteen minutes with a counsellor who will give you the honest comparison
notes: Never send a written competitor comparison to the lead

conditions: intent_score at 61 or above AND no reply for 72 hours
cta: Direct question about the actual blocker
notes: A previously hot lead going silent is a transactional blocker not a content gap

conditions: is_parent_enquiry is true AND parent asked to speak to someone
cohort_or_field_set: counsellor task at P1 in the evening window
cta: A slot when both of you are free
notes: Parents convert on conversation not on content

conditions: negative_response_flag is true
cohort_or_field_set: counsellor review before any further send
cta: none
notes: Human decides whether to close or recover

conditions: payment_failure_count at 2 or above
cta: Call within 30 minutes
notes: Two failures means a real payment problem not a reminder problem

conditions: order_value_inr above 40000 at any stage OR course is analyst_stack or a combo
cta: Short call on scope and outcomes
notes: High ATS products need a conversation

conditions: Same product question asked three or more times
cta: Answering this properly on a call
notes: Repetition means the automated answer did not land

conditions: eligibility_status is needs_review OR field_conflict_flags is not empty
cta: none
notes: Never reference a field that is under conflict

conditions: course_interest_primary is cfa_l1 AND life_stage is working professional
cta: Which weekly hour range is realistic
notes: Route to accelerate or fast track variants

conditions: course_interest_primary is cfa_l1 AND current_qualification is ca_qualified or mcom or mba
cohort_or_field_set: course_variant set to the CA and MBA fast paced batch
cta: The batch built for people who already know finance
notes: Real SKU on the SSEI course page. Use it rather than the generic product

conditions: course_interest_primary is cfa_l1 AND current_qualification is btech or bsc_stats or ba_eco
cohort_or_field_set: course_variant set to the special batch for non finance graduates
cta: The batch for people entering finance for the first time
notes: Real SKU. Removes the strongest objection before it is raised

conditions: course_interest_primary is frm_p1 AND current_role contains risk or credit or treasury or audit
cta: Where FRM sits against what you already do
notes: Role relevance beats generic FRM benefits

conditions: course_interest_primary is acca_full AND life_stage is class12_completed or college_ug_y1
cta: Parent guide with fees timelines and outcomes
notes: ACCA at this stage is a family decision

conditions: course_interest_primary is analyst_stack AND life_stage is college_ug_final or recent_graduate or job_seeker
cta: Skills check then your gap report
notes: Do not lead with certification language for a skills product

conditions: course_interest_primary is financial_modelling AND life_stage is job_seeker or career_switcher
cta: Which role are you targeting
notes: Role first then course

conditions: course_interest_primary is ca_final_afm AND previous_attempt_history is one_fail or two_plus_fails
cta: Topic level recovery plan for the next attempt
notes: Never open with the failure

conditions: course_interest_primary is cfa_l2 AND existing_courses_owned contains cfa_l1 from SSEI
cta: Plan for Level 2 before the window closes
notes: SSEI L1 to L2 retention is the strongest documented pattern in the business

conditions: course_interest_primary is equity_research
cta: What kind of research work do you want to do
notes: Equity research is not a standalone SKU on the current course list. Mapping must be confirmed. See open questions

conditions: course_interest_primary is unknown AND landing_page indicates a course
cta: You were looking at X. Is that what you want to plan for
notes: Confirm the inference. Never assert it

conditions: alternative_courses_considered has two or more entries
cta: Side by side on the two you are actually choosing between
notes: Compare only what the lead named

conditions: life_stage is school_9_10
cta: One page on how the finance path is built
notes: Nurture only. Quarterly cadence. Never a sales queue

conditions: life_stage is school_11 or school_12
cohort_or_field_set: primary_need set to career_clarity and decision_maker parent involved
cta: Two minute assessment
notes: Parent asset enters the journey at step 3 not step 1

conditions: life_stage is class12_completed
cta: Comparison of the three routes open to you now
notes: Highest urgency inside the school group. Decision is live

conditions: life_stage is college_ug_y1
cta: Roadmap for someone starting first year
notes: Long runway. Value the sequencing advice

conditions: life_stage is college_ug_y2
cta: Which of these roles sounds closest
notes: Employability framing starts here

conditions: life_stage is college_ug_final
cta: Skills check then your gap report
notes: Placement anxiety is the live emotion. Use it honestly

conditions: life_stage is recent_graduate or job_seeker
cta: Checklist recruiters actually screen on
notes: Time sensitivity is real for this group

conditions: life_stage is working_prof_0_2
cta: Where this actually takes people
notes: Progression framing

conditions: life_stage is working_prof_3_5 or working_prof_5_plus
cta: Plan built on your actual weekly hours
notes: Time is the objection not money

conditions: life_stage is career_switcher
cta: Someone who made this exact switch
notes: Proof must match the switch not the course

conditions: life_stage is parent_enquirer
cohort_or_field_set: tone set to parent and topics_to_avoid set to peer proof and slang
cta: Parent guide with fees timelines and outcomes
notes: Answer the outcome question first. Fees second. Never lead with urgency

conditions: life_stage is exam_failed_deferred
cohort_or_field_set: assigned_journey set to exam_retaker and tone set to diagnostic
cta: Twenty questions that show where the gaps are
notes: Diagnosis before offer. Never sympathy language

conditions: life_stage is comparing_qualifications
cta: The two you are actually choosing between
notes: Never push the highest value course. Push the correct one

conditions: life_stage is decided_course_attempt
cta: Which start date works
notes: No education. Logistics and proof only

conditions: life_stage is unknown AND source indicates a student context
cohort_or_field_set: life_stage inferred to a student band with confidence inferred_low
cta: Two options so I send the right thing
notes: Ask with tappable options. Never a form

conditions: life_stage is pg_student
cta: What does your programme not cover
notes: Marginal value over the degree is the only question that matters here

conditions: life_stage is finance_specialist
cta: Which topics are you checking coverage on
notes: Technical peer tone. Never explain basics to this cohort

conditions: life_stage is existing_candidate_frm AND course is frm_p2
cta: Plan for Part 2 before the sitting closes
notes: Part 1 to Part 2 progression mirrors the CFA level pattern

conditions: existing_student_status is active_student
cta: What the certification does not cover
notes: Owner is student success not a new lead counsellor

conditions: source_detail is college_seminar
cta: Continue from the session
notes: Reference the session topic not the venue

conditions: source_detail is inbound_call
cta: Answer to the exact question asked on the call
notes: An inbound caller outranks any organic engager

conditions: source_detail is walk_in
cta: Next step from the visit
notes: Highest intent offline signal

conditions: source_detail in meta_leadgen_ad
cohort_or_field_set: first_response_sla_minutes set to 5 and education depth set to high
cta: The specific thing the ad offered
notes: Speed matters most where intent is weakest

conditions: source_detail is google_search_ad
cohort_or_field_set: opening references the searched term intent
cta: Direct answer to what they searched for
notes: Search leads convert at 10 to 12 percent. Treat as high context

conditions: source_detail is organic_youtube AND event_topic is a faculty video
cta: Full session on that topic
notes: Never send the faculty orientation video to someone who arrived from a faculty video

conditions: source_detail is student_referral or alumni_referral
cohort_or_field_set: opening names the referrer with permission
cta: Same starting point as the person who sent you
notes: Confirm the referrer consented to being named

conditions: source_detail is resource_forwarded_by_friend
cohort_or_field_set: life_stage unknown and no promise exists
cta: Two options so I send the right version
notes: This lead never opted into anything. Consent first

conditions: source_detail is retargeting
cohort_or_field_set: opening acknowledges repeat contact without naming tracking
cta: The one thing most people check before deciding
notes: Never say we noticed you visited. It reads as surveillance

conditions: source_detail is scholarship_exam
cta: Where your result puts you
notes: These leads have already given effort. Acknowledge it

conditions: source_detail is previous_lost_lead or reactivation_campaign
cta: One line on what changed
notes: A new fact is mandatory. No new fact means no message

conditions: offline_accessible is true AND mode_preference is offline or hybrid
cta: Classroom batch nearest you
notes: Kolkata Delhi and Mumbai only. Verify the current centre list before use

conditions: mode_preference is offline AND offline_accessible is false
cta: What the live online class actually feels like
notes: Address the preference. Do not dismiss it

conditions: city_tier is tier_2 or tier_3
cohort_or_field_set: proof selection prefers a testimonial from a comparable city if one exists
cta: none
notes: City tier must never change fit or intent score. Logistics and proof only

conditions: country is not IN
cohort_or_field_set: time_zone set from country and call windows shifted
cta: none
notes: Check exam centre and currency handling before quoting

conditions: local_college_ecosystem is active_partnership
cohort_or_field_set: proof selection prefers the campus cohort
cta: none
notes: Relevant proof outperforms famous proof

conditions: course_interest_primary is unknown AND life_stage is unknown
cta: Two options so I send the right thing
notes: Never send a brochure to this lead

conditions: No rule above matched
cohort_or_field_set: assigned_journey set to unknown_course_discovery and counsellor sweep flagged
cta: One question
notes: Log every fallback hit. A rising fallback rate is a taxonomy failure

conditions: data_completeness_pct below 30 after two profiling attempts
cta: none
notes: Three unanswered questions means stop asking and let a counsellor try once
